peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Eased to about $102.18 on 4 Nov (Trading Economics), down roughly 1.4% on the day, as Iran's Rezaei called the US reply to its Hormuz-reopening terms “unconvincing” and new unverified IRGC tanker-mine claims kept risk elevated without a confirmed supply disruption. That's down from Tuesday's modest rebound after Monday's 7.6% selloff. Week-ago is this site's 28 Oct reading.

note: Oil and European gas eased on 4 November after Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, called the US reply to Iran's seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz “unconvincing,” a day after President Trump confirmed the US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island hit an anti-aircraft facility, calling it a “minor attack.” New Iranian claims of tankers destroyed by mines in the strait remain unverified and inconsistent between accounts.
